in_sanskrit.name: मुरुगान
in_sanskrit.meaning: God of War, Son of Shiva
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Muruga (मुरुगान) is a name of the Hindu god Skanda, who is also known as Kartikeya or Subrahmanya. He is the god of war, peace, and healing. Muruga is the son of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati.

in_hindi.name: मुरुग
in_hindi.long_meaning: Muruga (मुरुग) is a name of the Hindu god Skanda, also known as Kartikeya or Subrahmanya. He is the god of war, peace, and healing. Muruga is the son of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati. In Hindi, Muruga is also referred to as 'Sharda ke sone', which means 'son of Sharda (Goddess Durga)'.

in_tamil.name: முருக
in_tamil.long_meaning: Muruga (முருக) is a name of the Hindu god Skanda, also known as Kartikeya or Subrahmanya. He is the god of war, peace, and healing. Muruga is the son of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati. In Tamil, Muruga is referred to as 'varungodu varum ilangaiyalan', which means 'the one who came out of a Lingam (Shiva's symbol) when the Goddess Parvati prayed for a son'.

in_telugu.name: మూరుగ
in_telugu.long_meaning: Muruga (మూరుగ) is a name of the Hindu god Skanda, also known as Kartikeya or Subrahmanya. He is the god of war, peace, and healing. Muruga is the son of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati. In Telugu, Muruga is referred to as 'Shiva Pōjēśvaryudēśōṭṭuḍēśōṭṭu', which means 'the one who is the god of the gods, the god of Lord Shiva'.

in_marathi.name: Muruga
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Love and War
in_marathi.long_meaning: Muruga हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Muruga is the Hindu god of love, war, and victory. He is also known as Subramanya and Kartikeya. He is the son of Shiva and Parvati and is considered the god of war in the epic Ramayana.

in_bengali.name: Muruga
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Love and War
in_bengali.long_meaning: Muruga একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Muruga is the Hindu god of love, war, and victory. He is also known as Subramanya and Kartikeya. He is the son of Shiva and Parvati and is considered the god of war in the epic Ramayana.
